lesson.title: Es hat trotzdem geklappt

sentences.text: Mina hatte am Morgen einen wichtigen Termin in der Stadt.
sentences.natural_meaning: Mina had an important appointment in the city in the morning.

verb_help.usage: This is a simple-past form. In speech it is especially common with sein, haben, and modal verbs.

sentences.text: Der Bus war zu spät, und außerdem hat es stark geregnet.
sentences.natural_meaning: The bus was late, and it also rained heavily.

verb_help.usage: This is a simple-past form. In speech it is especially common with sein, haben, and modal verbs.
The sentence uses the present tense for a current action, routine, plan, or general fact.
geregnet is the past participle of regnen; it combines with haben to form the conversational past.

items.german: und außerdem hat es stark geregnet

sentences.text: Trotzdem ist Mina rechtzeitig im Büro angekommen.
sentences.natural_meaning: Nevertheless, Mina arrived at the office on time.

verb_help.usage: The sentence uses the present tense for a current action, routine, plan, or general fact.
angekommen is the past participle of ankommen; it combines with sein to form the conversational past.

sentences.text: Das Gespräch war schwierig, aber sie hat alles geschafft.
sentences.natural_meaning: The meeting was difficult, but she managed everything.

verb_help.usage: This is a simple-past form. In speech it is especially common with sein, haben, and modal verbs.

sentences.text: Am Ende war ihr Chef zufrieden, und der ganze Plan hat doch geklappt.
sentences.natural_meaning: In the end her manager was satisfied, and the whole plan worked after all.

lesson.initial_question: What was the unexpected positive result?
lesson.initial_answer: Mina arrived on time, managed the meeting, and her plan worked.
lesson.topic: a positive result despite a practical problem
